lemmas.value: Lemmas: automatic with corrections (the README's machine-readable metadata). A name's gold stem is its lemma's, so a stem the lemmatizer got wrong is a miss this prior is charged for.

classes.reason: a clitic or a case ending marks a name's role in its clause and leaves the referent where it was; a plural marks a group, so it is never stripped (the treebank's lemma of a plural is its singular, which is why this is declared and not searched)

lineage.selector: exhaustive sweep, then the plateau's least-claim point
